editorial:
If you love a good Halloween horror flick, this one brings the party to a bloody halt. Set in a small West Virginia town during the legendary Mountain Man Festival, the streets are packed with costumed partygoers ready for a wild night of music and mischief. But the fun turns deadly when an inbred family of hillbilly cannibals sets their sights on a group of visiting college students. The vibe is pure slasher chaos, mixing festival energy with backwoods terror. You get a colorful crowd of characters, plenty of Halloween atmosphere, and that familiar Wrong Turn feeling of being trapped far from help. It is loud, messy, and unapologetically gory, so if you are squeamish, you might want to look away.

The acting is serviceable and the pacing keeps things moving, though the story leans heavily on familiar slasher beats. The kills are creative and the festival setting adds a fun twist you do not usually see in this series. On the downside, the characters can feel thin and some moments drag. Still, if you enjoy campy horror with plenty of blood, this is a solid late-night watch. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the surviving college students make a desperate stand against the cannibal family during the festival chaos. The hillbillies are not easily stopped, and the bloodshed continues as partygoers flee in panic. The twist reveals that the family's bloodline runs deeper than expected, with more members lurking in the shadows. By the end, the festival is left in ruins, and the surviving students barely escape with their lives, setting up the possibility that the nightmare is far from over.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves campy slasher horror and Halloween vibes
